description: This Dart file defines the AppDataState class, managing application state related to metrics, workouts, goals, and notifications in a fitness app. It handles data loading, state updates, and optimistic UI updates for workouts.

classes.name: AppDataState
classes.description: A state management class extending ChangeNotifier that maintains data related to metrics, workouts, goals, and notifications, with methods to load, update, and perform optimistic UI updates.

methods.name: loadDashboard
methods.description: Asynchronously loads weekly metrics data and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: loadWorkouts
methods.description: Asynchronously loads list of workouts from repository.

methods.name: addWorkoutOptimistic
methods.description: Adds a temporary workout to the state immediately, attempts to create it on the server, then replaces the temporary entry with the server response or removes it on failure.

methods.name: upsertGoal
methods.description: Updates or inserts a goal in the state, with loading and error handling.
